messages:
elaine: Heads-up: after enabling broader preflight sampling last night, some tenants saw a big cost multiplier (2-3x). spotted it in the cost heatmap around 01:40 UTC.
nate: Which flag changed? the sample-rate to 3%?
elaine: yep. we bumped from 0.4% -> 3% to improve dim signal.
rohan: that will catch more mixed-dim batches and make the splitter do extra internal requests. multiplier effect expected.
pm-sara: product wants a short explainer for CS/finance. any mitigation besides rolling back?
elaine: short-term: rolling to 1% for trial-tier tenants and leaving higher tiers at 3% while we design a better flow.
nate: long-term: propose a cheap preflight-estimator API that returns est_units and prob_split WITHOUT invoking splitter. ingress can call it and route accordingly.
rohan: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate
{ "n": 100, "avg_bytes": 1200, "dims_hint": [512, 768] }
-> { "est_units": 2345, "prob_split": 0.8, "est_confidence": 0.6 }
```
rohan: estimator must be conservative (bias toward predicting split) so we don't under-provision. will add a config toggle for bias level.
pm-sara: console UX: show "estimated cost" in the quick-run panel and a yellow "may fragment" badge when prob_split > 0.5. include a link to "how to avoid splits" (batching tips).
nate: telemetry: store estimator_id on requests when estimator was used so we can measure estimator accuracy. keep estimator samples at 0.5% by default for metrics.
infra-bot: created rollback automation: if splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 90m of sample-config-change, auto-revert sampling flag (runbook id R-809).
elaine: also add a console banner when sampling config flips for 24h so CS/Finance aren't surprised.
rohan: small runtime change: splitter should accept a header X-Estimator-Id and log it in traces. I'll include that in the PR.
nate: I'll own the API PR + perf bench (p95 < 5ms target). will also include a canary toggle.
pm-sara: roadmap: canary next week, console mock next sprint. I'll prep the customer note template.
elaine: filing follow-ups: OBS ticket for telemetry quota, API PR, console mock thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
